## Added

- Added a live wallpaper scaling option in General Settings (Original, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p). A lower resolution reduces GPU usage and power consumption. The scaled copy is created once with Windows' built-in transcoder and the original file is kept.

## Changes

- Changed the default live wallpaper playback to 720p to keep GPU usage low.
- Changed the minimum supported Windows version to Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041).

## Fixed

- Fixed a live wallpaper that kept playing in the background after a regular wallpaper was set.
- Fixed favorite wallpapers added from the details window not showing up or being overwritten later.

## Download

Windows x64 Setup EXE.
